questions.question: Who scored the most points in calendar year 2017?
questions.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: Calendar 2017 (game_date), not the season code. One keyed row; the name is a label.

questions.question: Who are the top five scorers in the 2016-17 NBA season?
questions.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE season = 2016 GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 5
questions.note: The 2016-17 season is season code 2016 (the year the season started), which the games and player_game_stats columns describe. A clarification between season code and calendar year is also accepted; calendar 2016 is not.

questions.question: Show monthly scoring totals during calendar 2017.
questions.sql: WITH months(month) AS (VALUES ('2017-01-01'),('2017-02-01'),('2017-03-01'),('2017-04-01'),('2017-05-01'),('2017-06-01'),('2017-07-01'),('2017-08-01'),('2017-09-01'),('2017-10-01'),('2017-11-01'),('2017-12-01')) SELECT m.month AS month, COALESCE(SUM(p.pts), 0) AS total_points FROM months m LEFT JOIN dev.player_game_stats p ON date(p.game_date, 'start of month') = m.month GROUP BY m.month ORDER BY m.month
questions.note: A monthly grain over calendar 2017. The reference lists every month with a month without games as zero; AI-written SQL may list only the months that had games, which is the same series without the empty months.

alternatives.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-01', game_date) AS month, SUM(pts) AS total_points FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', game_date) AS month, SUM(pts) AS total_points FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Compare LeBron James and Stephen Curry in 2017 on points, rebounds and assists per game.
questions.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) * 1.0 / SUM(played) AS points_per_game, SUM(reb) * 1.0 / SUM(played) AS rebounds_per_game, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(played) AS assists_per_game FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 AND player_name IN ('LeBron James', 'Stephen Curry') GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY player_name

alternatives.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS points_per_game, SUM(reb) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS rebounds_per_game, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS assists_per_game FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 AND player_name IN ('LeBron James', 'Stephen Curry') GROUP BY player_id, player_name

questions.note: Two named players, keyed; per-game denominators are games taken part in (played = 1) or game records. Ratios over the physical columns, no semantic metric exists.

questions.question: Who are our most efficient shooters in 2017? Use field-goal percentage and at least 100 attempts.
questions.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(fgm) * 1.0 / SUM(fga) AS field_goal_pct FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING SUM(fga) >= 100 ORDER BY field_goal_pct DESC LIMIT 10

alternatives.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(fgm) * 1.0 / SUM(fga) AS field_goal_pct FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING SUM(fga) >= 100 ORDER BY field_goal_pct DESC

questions.note: sum(made)/sum(attempts), never an average of per-game percentages; the 100-attempt minimum applies after aggregation. Ten or all qualifying players.

questions.question: Who made the most three-pointers in 2017? Show attempts and shooting percentage too.
questions.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(fg3m) AS three_pointers_made, SUM(fg3a) AS three_point_attempts, SUM(fg3m) * 1.0 / SUM(fg3a) AS three_point_pct FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY three_pointers_made DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: Ranked by makes; attempts and the ratio of sums shown beside.

alternatives.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(fg3m) AS three_pointers_made, SUM(fg3a) AS three_point_attempts, SUM(fg3m) * 1.0 / SUM(fg3a) AS three_point_pct FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY three_pointers_made DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives.note: the superlative answered as a ranking whose first row is the leader

questions.question: Who had the best assist-to-turnover ratio in 2017 with at least 20 games?
questions.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(turnover) AS assist_to_turnover_ratio FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING SUM(played) >= 20 ORDER BY assist_to_turnover_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

alternatives.sql: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(turnover) AS assist_to_turnover_ratio FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) >= 20 ORDER BY assist_to_turnover_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(turnover) AS assist_to_turnover_ratio FROM dev.player_game_stats WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', game_date) AS INTEGER) = 2017 GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN played = 1 THEN game_id END) >= 20 ORDER BY assist_to_turnover_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives.note: the superlative answered as a ranking whose first row is the best

questions.note: A ratio of sums with a games threshold after aggregation; the best one player.
